title: Girar en torno a: el eje central de una política o un debate

sections.content: Girar en torno a (to revolve around, to center on) names the central axis that a policy, debate, or set of activities organizes itself around -- useful for describing what really drives a broader set of decisions. It's followed by a noun phrase. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: La política estadounidense había girado en torno a un único eje: contener la influencia comunista.
items.english: US policy had revolved around a single axis: containing communist influence.

items.spanish: Esa política dejó de girar en torno al anticomunismo y comenzó a organizarse alrededor de tres nuevos ejes.
items.english: That policy stopped revolving around anti-communism and began organizing itself around three new axes.

items.spanish: La Iniciativa para las Américas giraba en torno a la idea de crear una zona de libre comercio hemisférica.
items.english: The Enterprise for the Americas Initiative centered on the idea of creating a hemispheric free trade zone.

items.spanish: La política hacia los países andinos comenzó a girar cada vez más en torno al combate contra el narcotráfico.
items.english: Policy toward the Andean countries increasingly began to revolve around the fight against drug trafficking.

sections.content: Girar en torno a works well for describing a shift in emphasis over time (dejó de girar en torno a X y comenzó a girar en torno a Y) -- it's more dynamic than simply centrarse en, which just states a current focus.
